scientific_integrity: All-size identities proved by finite Rademacher-polynomial algebra. Exhaustive exact finite enumeration is independent corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Independent fair tournament edges; predetermined marked vertex; no whole-law order, biased model, or conditional fourth cumulant. General older subgraph-count machinery may contain an implicit formula.
title: Exact score-conditioned skewness of cyclic triples in random tournaments
